notes: Schedule D line 1a column (h) = ST (d)-(e) (ADR-0058 Decision 1). v2 extends the guard: besides the short-term covered family (f1099b.covered-st), the rule publishes only when the basis (f1099b.covered-st-basis) and proceeds (f1099b.covered-st-proceeds) sets it subtracts are closed at the current horizon. Why: collect reads closure only when its set is empty; with any member recorded it sums what is present and never asks whether the set is complete, so v1 published a partial line 1a gain when a family had a recorded amount and an unanswered or stale closure. With the guard, an unclosed family blocks this rule SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED, naming the first unclosed set in the order listed, and every line that reads it waits. A complete return (every family closed at the current horizon, or closed empty) publishes exactly what v1 did. Residual, not closed here: a closure attested true over an amount that was never recorded still publishes the smaller sum, because the engine cannot tell a blank from 'nothing'.
